message:
feat(data): enforce low-disk Run admission (#144)

Deliver the PRD low-disk Run boundary after independent content review and all four required checks on the exact head. Preserve strict execution policy and original audit/fencing behavior.

The prior Windows normal-finish failure remains an unresolved reliability risk tracked in #145; current green CI does not establish the cause, a baseline classification, or a repair. Accept this risk for internal development, retain the diagnostic assertions and failed originals, and verify the merged main push separately.

Constraint: Keep four required checks, strict/admin protection and the 25-minute CI limit unchanged.
Not-tested: Physical power loss, user Windows desktops/ARM64, real paid models and 10h soak.
